name: Microsoft cloud & AI investment, Malaysia
status_detail: Watchlist · investment announced May 2024; site undisclosed
summary: Microsoft announced a US$2.2 billion investment in Malaysia to fuel cloud and AI infrastructure. The specific site or sites have not been publicly confirmed, so this record is deliberately unpinned.
why_it_matters: One of the largest single digital-infrastructure commitments in Malaysia's history. Where it physically lands matters for power, land and jobs in the Klang Valley.
questions_to_follow: Which site or sites are officially confirmed, and in which state?
What capacity (MW) and timeline are attached to the confirmed site?
location_precision: No public site announcement found at the time of review. This record is intentionally unpinned rather than guessed.

sources.publisher: MIDA (Malaysian Investment Development Authority) news roundup
sources.title: Microsoft announced a US$2.2 billion investment to fuel cloud and AI capabilities in Malaysia

history.event: US$2.2 billion investment announced during a visit to Kuala Lumpur.
